standard.description: Conventional method/engineering/clinical papers whose figures and tables are readable directly from the source asset and caption. Preserve preview, right-side viewer, bilingual captions and inline figure/table links, but do not create the full-screen figure-study layer.
required_asset_features: inline figure/table links at the original mention position

figure_intensive.description: CNS-family main/sub-journal papers and biology/bioinformatics-heavy discovery papers where dense multi-panel figures carry the scientific argument. Preserve all standard asset features and additionally create panel/logical-block figure study.
required_asset_features: inline figure/table links at the original mention position
panel-by-panel or logical-block explanations grounded in the source figure and legend

engineering_journal_patterns: Computer Methods and Programs in Biomedicine
automatic_rules.rule: CNS-family or biology/bioinformatics-heavy papers use figure_intensive. Conventional engineering/method papers remain standard unless the biological-analysis signals independently trigger figure_intensive. Manual paper-plan override always wins.
